name: temporal_ssl_continuation_ablation_v1
confirmation_rule: Confirm continuation-stage temporal SSL only if V19 minus V26 worst strict/nominal/branch safe success is at least 0.03 and the paired hierarchical 95% interval for the endpoint attaining the control worst case has positive lower bound.
